Successful batch requests cost 50% of the real-time inference price.

You are billed only for successfully executed requests.

Batch is not eligible for context caching, free quotas, or other promotions.

Additional thinking tokens are billed at the output token price.

Each JSONL result exposes response.body.usage.prompt_tokens, response.body.usage.completion_tokens, and response.body.usage.total_tokens.

The submitted body may set enable_thinking.
